query: I'm the author of draft PR acme/pipeline#5708, which closes acme/pipeline#5700 (swap the default Glue version). The diff also deletes the unused Batch/Bedrock block in `jobs/run.py` (lines 40-88, no replacement lines), removes the credentials step from `.github/workflows/scala.yml` (line 22), and changes the Glue default in `config/defaults.yaml` line 9. Write the PR body and update the PR.
expected_behavior: Checks whether the current user is the PR author before choosing a comment mechanism
Proposes or posts annotations for the Batch/Bedrock removal and the workflow credentials step without the user asking, since both go beyond the linked issue
The annotations are posted as standalone line comments (for example `gh api .../pulls/5708/comments`), not as a pending review and not through `add_pr_review_comment`
The note for the pure-deletion block anchors on a context line beside the deleted hunk and says 'the block below' or 'the block above'
In PowerShell, line numbers are assigned to plain `[int]` variables before being passed to `-F line=`
Each annotation starts with `note:` and ends with <!--:robot:--> as its literal last line
